skills.review: Subagent read SKILL.md, all 10 references and the install code (24/09/2026). No hooks, no settings/MCP/shell-profile edits, no postinstall scripts. Vendored by hand, NOT via `playwright-cli install --skills`: that silently cp -r overwrites ~/.claude/skills/playwright-cli, and its skillCheck.js nags on any local edit. Local changes: allowed-tools narrowed to Bash(playwright-cli:*) (upstream also allows npm/npx); an estate-rules block bans state-save/--persistent/--profile/cookie-get on real accounts, attach --cdp/--extension, package installs, and GitHub PR attachment uploads. skills.review: Global CLI backing the playwright-cli skill. No postinstall scripts; installs no browsers (only `install` / `install-browser` do). Checks registry.npmjs.org once a day for an update notice; NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER=1 disables it.

skills.name: playwright-mcp
skills.review: User-scope MCP server: npx -y @playwright/mcp@0.0.82 --isolated --headless --output-dir ~/.local/state/playwright-mcp. Pinned rather than the README's @latest. --isolated keeps the browser profile in memory (the default persists logins under ~/Library/Caches/ms-playwright/mcp-*). Never add --save-session, --user-data-dir, --storage-state or --caps=storage. README: 'Playwright MCP is not a security boundary.' Microsoft recommends the CLI+skill for coding agents and MCP for long exploratory loops.
